KXNCAAF1HWINNER.quote: If the score is tied at the conclusion of the first-half, all team strikes resolve to No and the Tie strike resolves to Yes
KXNCAAF1HWINNER.reason: Three-way first-half result (team A, team B, Tie strikes) settled on the score at halftime; that is the first-half margin mechanism of quarter_and_half_sides, with the tie as an explicit strike. Postponed games stay open up to two weeks.

KXNCAAFCS.quote: wins the 2025-26 College Football FCS National Championship
KXNCAAFCS.reason: Outright winner of the 2025-26 FCS National Championship per team strike; a season-level bracket/title outcome, so season_futures fits (lower division changes data sources, not the mechanism). Rules now confirm the prior NO_LISTING guess.

KXNCAAFD3.quote: wins the 2025-26 College Football Division III National Championship
KXNCAAFD3.reason: Outright winner of the 2025-26 Division III National Championship per team strike; season-level playoff/title outcome, same mechanism as season_futures. Rules text confirms the earlier unverified NO_LISTING classification.

KXNCAAFD3GAME.quote: If the game is declared a tie, the market will resolve to 50/50 for both teams.
KXNCAAFD3GAME.reason: Single-game winner market for a Division III playoff game (North Central vs John Carroll); full-game moneyline mechanism. Variant: a declared tie settles 50/50 and an unplayed game settles at a fair price, unlike the 'no ties' wording of the archetype target.

KXNCAAFPREPACK2ML.quote: If Oregon wins against Indiana, Ole Miss wins against Miami (FL)
KXNCAAFPREPACK2ML.reason: Pre-packaged two-leg moneyline parlay across two separate CFP games; YES only if both named teams win. Outcome is the joint probability of independent-ish game results, not any single-game archetype; no void/tie handling is stated in the rules.

KXNCAAFPREPACK3ML.quote: If Texas Tech wins against Oregon, Indiana wins against Alabama, Georgia wins against Ole Miss
KXNCAAFPREPACK3ML.reason: Three-leg moneyline parlay over three Jan 1 2026 CFP games; resolves YES only if all three named teams win. Joint multi-game outcome, so it belongs with the other pre-pack parlays rather than game_moneyline_spread.

KXNCAAFPREPACK4ML.quote: If Ohio St. wins against Miami (FL), Texas Tech wins against Oregon
KXNCAAFPREPACK4ML.reason: Four-leg moneyline parlay spanning Dec 31 2025 and Jan 1 2026 CFP games; YES requires all four named winners. Product of separate game-win events across a slate; no leg-void rule is stated in the rules text.

KXNCAAFPREPACKSGP.quote: If Miami (FL) covers +7.5 spread, Total score is under 48.5 points
KXNCAAFPREPACKSGP.reason: Same-game parlay: Miami (FL) +7.5 AND total under 48.5 in the Jan 19 2026 title game. Joint margin-total distribution within one game (correlated legs), filed with the pre-pack parlays since the outcome is a conjunction of existing-archetype legs.

multi_leg_parlay_packs.label: College football pre-packaged parlays (multi-game moneyline and same-game combos)
contract_types: MVE NCAAF Pre Pack (same-game spread + total)
multi_leg_parlay_packs.target: Probability that every leg of a pre-packaged combination resolves YES jointly: several named teams all win their games, or a spread cover and a total side in the same game both hit.
multi_leg_parlay_packs.why_distinct: Single-game archetypes price one marginal outcome; these settle on a conjunction of legs, so the target is a joint probability that needs the dependence structure between legs (near-independent across games, strongly correlated margin/total within a game), which no existing archetype models.
